test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Pranav gave 30% of the money he had to his wife, and 86% of the remaining to his two children. Half of the amount left was spent on other things, and the remaining amount of ₹98,000 was deposited in the bank. How much money did he have initially?
solution:
**Given:**

Pranav gave 30% of the money he had to his wife, and 86% of the remaining to his two children. Half of the amount left was spent on other things, and the remaining amount of ₹98,000 was deposited in the bank.

**Formula used:**

Let the initial amount be ₹X.

After giving 30% to his wife, he has 70% of X left.

Then, he gives 86% of the remaining to his children, so he is left with 14% of 70% of X.
